entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker. I want a refund.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
There's nothing wrong with it. I just changed my mind, okay? It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it. I want my money back now.
I understand. Let me just pull up your purchase history... I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 18 days ago.
And? So what? Just process the return.

Well, for the VeloBand Pulse model specifically, our return policy is 10 days from the date of delivery. This is because once the device is activated, the hardware is permanently linked to a user's account. Since you're at day 18, we're outside of that return window.

ARE YOU KIDDING ME? Ten days?! That's ridiculous! Your website says 90 days! This is a complete bait-and-switch! I want to speak to your manager right now. This is unacceptable, and I'll be posting reviews about this scam everywhere!

I completely understand your frustration, and I apologize if the policy wasn't clear. The 90-day policy applies to our apparel and other gear, but specialized electronics like the Pulse have that specific 10-day window noted in the terms. My manager would have to provide you with the same information, but I do have an alternative solution that many customers find very helpful.
What solution? It had better end with me getting my money back.

While I can't process a direct return, I can guide you to our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform we created for our community to buy and sell their gear. Since the Pulse is a newer, high-demand item, they tend to sell very quickly, allowing you to recoup most of your cost.
A resale marketplace? You want me to sell it myself? Why should I have to do the work?

It's a way to ensure you can still get value from the device outside the return period. It gives you full control over the price, and you're selling to a community that is specifically looking for VeloFit products. I can email you a direct link with simple instructions on how to create a listing.
Hmph. Fine. If it sells as fast as you say it will... send me the link. But if this doesn't work out, you'll be hearing from me again.
Of course. I am sending that email to you right now. You should see it in your inbox within a few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
